review_candidates.description: About Us : - We are India's leading political consulting organization dedicated to provide high quality professional support for political campaigns. We strongly believe that the nation will best benefit from an enlightened political leadership in the form of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and are proud to have previously contributed in a similar capacity in the momentous election campaign of 2014, 2019,2024 and various subsequent state elections. - Our work includes envisioning and executing innovative electioneering campaigns, facilitating capacity building of grassroots cadre and shaping governance. We add professional aspects to the strengths of the scores of grassroots workers supporting the Prime Minister and ensure optimal electoral results not as an end in itself but to add to the Prime Minister's vision for a developed India. Our work leverages on-ground activities, data analytics, research and new age media as a force multiplier for the Prime Minister's messages and actions. - We comprise a diverse group of dedicated individuals including former management consultants, lawyers, engineers, political theorists, public policy professionals and other varied sectors from premier institutes and corporates with the unified objective of meaningfully contributing to the polity of the nation. A creative and skilled Video Editor who understands short-form content, Telugu internet culture, memes, humour, satire and political communication, and can turn briefs, ideas and raw footage into engaging and impactful video content. Responsibilities • Edit Reels, short-form videos, meme videos, political content and other social media content. • Edit speeches, interviews, news clips, campaign videos, parody videos and other digital content. • Create video content using original and repurposed footage. • Take a brief, understand the team's needs and specifications, and translate it into effective video communication. • Develop and review scripts and raw material for videos wherever required. • Trim footage segments and put together sequences with logical sequencing, strong pacing and smooth running. • Create rough cuts and final cuts based on the requirements. • Add and effectively use music, dialogues, graphics, subtitles, text, sound effects, transitions and visual effects wherever required. • Create strong hooks, pacing, transitions and visual storytelling to keep viewers engaged and improve audience retention. • Understand and effectively use Telugu meme formats, humour, satire, internet trends and cultural references. • Create engaging political and social-media content that is relevant to the target audience. • Work closely with content writers, designers and creative teams to execute ideas and creative briefs in a fast-paced work environment. • Consult and coordinate with stakeholders across various teams and incorporate feedback into final outputs. • Consistently create impactful communication collaterals across various mediums. • Stay updated with current video-editing trends, viral formats, AI video tools, new content styles, editing technologies and industry best practices, and implement them to improve efficiency and output quality. • Handle multiple projects simultaneously and deliver quality work within tight deadlines. Requirements • 21–27 years old. • 1–8 years of work experience in an art/design or video-editing environment, preferably with an advertising agency (ATL/digital), brand or startup. • Strong command of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. • Proficiency in CapCut or similar editing software. • Experience with Final Cut is an advantage. • Hands-on experience with AI tools for video creation, editing and content production. • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and CorelDRAW. • Good understanding of Telugu language and Telugu meme culture. • Good awareness of Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and national politics. • Strong understanding of short-form video, audience retention and current content trends. • Strong sense of timing, humour, visual storytelling, music and aesthetics. • Ability to create engaging content from raw footage, scripts and basic creative briefs. • Ability to translate a brief into well-crafted communication content. • Familiarity with special effects, animation, 3D and compositing. • Keen eye for aesthetics, visual quality and attention to detail. • Solid knowledge of design and visual principles. • Creative mind with strong storytelling skills. • Fast, creative and enthusiastic, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and under pressure. • Strong multitasking skills and the ability to work methodically and meet deadlines. • Previous experience in political, meme, news or social media video editing is a plus. • Should have experience creating posts, ads or banners for social media in a previous role. • Editing machine/desktop is mandatory. P.S. This is a contractual role till June 2027.
